description: This source file defines an internal, immutable structure 'RingRange' within the Orleans.Runtime.GrainDirectory namespace. It models a contiguous range of values on a ring (circular numerical space), with methods for creating, comparing, and checking containment within the range. The file is focused on the implementation and manipulation of ring ranges, including special cases like full and empty ranges, and supports serialization and formatting.

classes.name: RingRange
classes.description: Represents a contiguous range of values on a ring, supporting creation, containment checks, intersection, difference, and serialization.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new RingRange with specified start and end points.

methods.name: FromPoint
methods.description: Creates a Range representing a single point on the ring.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size (number of values) within the range.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares a point to the range to determine its position relative to the range.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a point or GrainId is within the range.

methods.name: SizePercent
methods.description: Returns the size of the range as a percentage of the maximum uint value.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two RingRange instances are equal.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code for the range.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the range.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Checks if this range intersects with another.

methods.name: Complement
methods.description: Returns the complement of the range, covering the values outside the range.

methods.name: Intersections
methods.description: Returns the intersection(s) between this range and another.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Returns parts of this range that are not in the other range.
